name: Alicanto critical QA
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, staging]
  workflow_call:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install -e . pytest
      - run: python -m pytest -q
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci && npm test
  staging:
    needs: tests
    environment: staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install -e .
      - name: Load durable iteration ledger
        run: |
          mkdir -p data/autopilot
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin autopilot-state >/dev/null; then
            git fetch origin autopilot-state
            if git cat-file -e FETCH_HEAD:data/autopilot/ledger.json 2>/dev/null; then
              git show FETCH_HEAD:data/autopilot/ledger.json > data/autopilot/ledger.json
            fi
          fi
      - name: Build priority statistical deep analysis
        run: python scripts/build_statistics_deep_analysis.py
      - name: Build fresh material epidemiology signal
        run: python scripts/build_epidemiology_snapshot.py
      - name: Recurate current history without external lookups
        run: python scripts/export_web_snapshot.py --input data/history/superintendencia_signals.json --offline
      - name: Validate and export the canonical Global Intelligence sample
        run: python scripts/export_global_intelligence.py
      - run: python scripts/product_report.py
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:browser
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: staging-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            artifacts/
            test-results/
            web/
  reviewer:
    needs: staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install -e .
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: staging-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
          path: reviewed
      - run: python scripts/review_candidate.py --web reviewed/web --sha "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: reviewer-${{ github.sha }}
          path: artifacts/review.json
